name: 43469 · Woodville, OH
findings: ZIP 43469 (Woodville) has 18 nonprofit organizations. 9 of them (50%) list at least one way to get involved on their websites: membership, volunteering, public events, or civic and political action.
The most common is membership, listed by 7 organizations.
Economic development organizations are the largest group offering opportunities (57% of those with an identified type).
Compared with 10 similar places, ZIP 43469 (Woodville) has more organizations offering opportunities per resident.

observations.title: More organizations list membership
observations.text: Per resident, more organizations in ZIP 43469 (Woodville) list membership on their websites than in 10 similar places (about 2.4 times the typical level).

confidence.text: Based on 7 organizations here; 50% of all organizations here have no identified type.

observations.question: Why are groups to join so common here? Who takes part, and who might not be reached?
